name: Mortarion’s Hammer
legend: The armoured might of the Death Guard has warped and corroded over the millennia, but it remains prodigious. Formed into grinding spearheads and smog-belching batteries, squadrons of ancient battle tanks and Daemon Engines mass their blunt and brutish power before unleashing it on the foe. Their onslaught is heralded by a rain of rust-pocked artillery shells, alchemical munitions and brittleglass plague-spheres hurled from infernal field guns and towering Daemon Engines behind the lines. The foe cower beneath this explosive deluge, many torn apart by thunderous detonations or eaten away by whirling spore clouds. Amid the devastation surge reaper colonies of Plague Marines mounted in Rhinos and Land Raiders. These warriors are masters of capitalising upon their foes’ dismay and horror, tearing the guts out of the most formidable defence lines even as carrion-feeding war engines close in to finish off knots of resistance. Many a siege has been swiftly broken in this way by the fall of Mortarion’s Hammer.

rules.name: Miasmic Bombardment
rules.legend: In the wake of preparatory bombardment by artillery weapons both forbidden and foul, the surviving foe are left reeling amidst clouds of plague smog. With their flesh running like tallow and their weapons rusting in their hands, they will be hard-pressed to fight back.
rules.description_html:
At the start of the battle round, select a number of enemy units more than 12" away from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are Afflicted. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.

stratagems.name: DRAWN TO DESPAIR
stratagems.legend: Those who languish in misery or cower in terror make themselves easy targets for the Death Guard.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Death Guard unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: FONT OF FILTH
stratagems.legend: As though afflicted with some awful vomiting sickness, this vehicle's weapons retch an endless stream of fire at the enemy, heaving themselves empty even as it storms into the enemy lines.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

stratagems.name: BLIGHTED LAND
stratagems.legend: Firing diseased submunitions or belching swarms of daemonic parasites from its hull, this war engine befouls the battlefield as it advances.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.
stratagems.description_text:

TARGET: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.

stratagems.name: STINKING MIRE
stratagems.legend: Attempting to counterattack Death Guard can leave foes floundering amidst bubbling filth.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as the target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).

stratagems.name: EYESTINGER STORM
stratagems.legend: Swarms of these revolting insects burrow hives into the hulls of Death Guard vehicles. Drawn to sickened prey, they boil forth in buzzing masses and descend on the foe, spreading panic and horror.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Command phase.

TARGET: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS GRIND
stratagems.legend: When the armoured vehicles of the Death Guard advance, they plough through - or straight over- anything that stands in their way.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One Death Guard Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

enhancements.name: Eye of Affliction
enhancements.legend: Peering at the world through this bloated yellow orb, the bearer of this vile gift sees the souls of the sickened burning bright as targeting flares no matter how their victims try to hide.
enhancements.description_html: DEATH GUARD model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [ignores cover] ability while targeting an Afflicted enemy unit.
enhancements.description_text: DEATH GUARD model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [ignores cover] ability while targeting an Afflicted enemy unit.

enhancements.name: Bilemaw Blight
enhancements.legend: This foul sorcerer has been blessed with a unique affliction that allows them to inflate their body like a repulsive bellows before vomiting forth a pressurised torrent of filth that would do any Great Unclean One proud.
enhancements.description_html: Malignant Plaguecaster only. At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, add 12" to the Range characteristics of the bearer’s Plague Wind weapon.

enhancements.name: Shriekworm Familiar
enhancements.legend: This daemonic familiar lives in the champion’s flesh and watches with bitter paranoia for enemy threats. Should it spot a counterattack from the foe, it bursts forth to scream its shrill warning.
enhancements.description_html: DEATH GUARD model only. Once per battle round, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Tendrilous Emissions
enhancements.legend: This warrior has gained greater control of the vile fumes that billow from their armour, willing them forward like coiling tentacles to wreathe targets and guide in the fire of allied war engines.
enhancements.description_html: Lord of Virulence only. While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly Death Guard Vehicle units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability, and each time one of those VEHICLE units makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit visible to the bearer, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
